title: Market Deep-Dive & Predictive Report
description: Asset-agnostic schema for a market research report. The asset, the prediction horizons, and the research areas actually covered are all recorded in metadata.request, so the document is self-describing. Research findings are keyed by area rather than by fixed section names, so the same schema fits a cryptocurrency, a stock, an ETF, an index, a commodity or an FX pair. All percentage fields are plain numbers (e.g. 1.5 means +1.5%). Price fields are in metadata.request.asset.quote_currency, or index points for an index.

market_status.description: Trading status of the asset's primary venue at generation time. A 24/7 venue is normally 'open'.

last_close_utc.description: UTC time of the most recent regular-session close. Required in practice whenever market_status is not 'open'.

next_open_utc.description: UTC time of the next regular-session open, when the market is not currently open.

asset_price.description: Current price or index level, in the quote currency or index points

price_observed_at_utc.description: UTC time the primary price was observed. When the market is closed this is the last-session close; when open it should be within 15 minutes of generation.

market_cap.description: Market capitalisation in the quote currency, if applicable and retrieved

primary_price_source.description: URL used for the authoritative price reading

price_cross_check.description: Price or level from an independent source

price_cross_check_observed_at_utc.description: UTC time the cross-check price was observed

price_cross_check_source.description: URL used for the independent cross-check

price_cross_check_provider.description: Independent provider publishing the cross-check price

price_cross_check_instrument.description: Instrument actually quoted by the cross-check, e.g. '^GSPC', 'SPY (ETF proxy)', 'ES front-month future'. Set whenever it differs from the primary instrument.

price_cross_check_is_proxy.description: True when the cross-check quotes a proxy instrument rather than the same instrument as the primary source. Explain the basis in data_quality_notes.

predictions.description: One prediction per entry of metadata.request.timeframes, in the same order.

confidence_protocol.description: Record of the confidence-threshold protocol: required whenever any initial confidence score was < 60.

plan_executed.description: Steps taken to acquire missing data

report_date_utc.description: Current date (UTC); must match the date of metadata.generated_at_utc

overview.description: Brief overview of the market state and sentiment

market_state.description: One-line characterization, e.g. 'oversold, deleveraged, quietly accumulated'

key_metrics.description: Headline badges, e.g. session change, a sentiment reading, distance from all-time high

price_action.description: Two observation windows: a short one (an hour, or the final hour of the most recent session) and a long one (a day, or the last full trading session). Each names itself via window_label.

research_findings.description: One entry per research area in metadata.request.research_areas, in the same order. Areas are not fixed by this schema: they are either supplied by the caller or derived by the skill from the asset class, so the same structure carries crypto whale flows, equity institutional positioning, commodity inventories, or anything else.

sentiment_index.description: Optional structured sentiment gauge, filled when a sentiment area was researched and a headline index exists. The scale is declared explicitly so a 0-100 Fear & Greed index, a VIX level, or a put/call ratio all fit.

name.description: e.g. 'Crypto Fear & Greed Index', 'CNN Fear & Greed Index', 'CBOE VIX'

scale_min.description: Lower bound of the index's scale

scale_max.description: Upper bound of the index's scale

data_quality_notes.description: Notes on source discrepancies, discarded readings, cross-validation, any proxy instrument used, and any requested research area that could not be covered

retrieved_at_utc.description: UTC time the source was accessed

usage.description: Full content or API data was retrieved and used

reason.description: Why access failed, e.g. 'empty response body'

request.description: The inputs this report was generated for, echoed verbatim so the report is self-describing and independently checkable.

quote_currency.description: e.g. 'USD'. For an index quoted in points, the currency it is denominated in.

price_unit.description: Human-readable unit, e.g. 'USD per BTC', 'index points'

timeframes.description: The ordered, verbatim prediction horizon entries supplied by the caller, in any phrasing that resolves to a future UTC instant. predictions[] must correspond one-to-one in this order.

timeframes_source.description: Where the timeframes came from, when read from a file or other named origin

research_areas.description: The ordered research areas actually covered. Either supplied verbatim by the caller, or derived by the skill as a reasonable set for this asset class. research_findings[] must correspond one-to-one in this order.

research_areas_source.description: 'caller' when the areas were supplied by the requester and used as given; 'derived' when the skill chose them from the asset class.

research_finding.description: What the research turned up for one area. Deliberately shape-neutral so any area fits: narrative summary, discrete observations, and optional numeric or dated readings.

area.description: The research area, matching its entry in metadata.request.research_areas

summary.description: What this area showed, and what it implies for the predictions

observations.description: Discrete findings: events, flows, readings, filings. One per string.

data_points.description: Optional numeric or dated readings worth surfacing, e.g. a scheduled release, an index level, a net flow

when.description: Date, period, or scheduled timing, free-form

probability_pct.description: For a forward-looking item, its assessed probability

notes.description: Caveats, gaps, or why a sub-topic could not be covered

timeframe_id.description: Slug derived from the timeframe entry: lowercase, each run of non-alphanumeric characters replaced with '_', leading and trailing '_' trimmed. Unique within predictions.

timeframe_label.description: The timeframe entry from metadata.request.timeframes, optionally followed by one parenthesized annotation

predicted_move_pct.description: Headline predicted price movement in percent; the probability-weighted mean of the scenarios

range_pct.description: Expected range of movement in percent; min must not exceed max

reasoning.description: Justification tying the prediction to the research findings

source_urls.description: Accessed sources that directly support the prediction

scenarios.description: Probability-weighted paths; probabilities must sum to 100

expected_move_pct.description: Outcome of this scenario in percent

notes.description: Caveats, e.g. how an ambiguous horizon was resolved, or a horizon that lands while the market is shut

window_label.description: What this window covers, e.g. 'last hour', 'last 24 hours', 'last full trading session'
